right.title: Amanuel Amlak
right.description:
#Zemari_Dagmawi_Derbe
#orthodox_mezmur


ሼር ላይክ ሰብስክራይብ  በማድረግ ለሌሎች ያካፍሉ።
right.lyrics_amharic:
አማኑኤል አምላክ ምስጋና ይገባሀል
ለአዳም ልጆች ሁሉ ህይወትን ሰጥተሀል
እልልልልልልልልታ ይገባል ለታላቁ ጌታ
ምሕረትን ለሰጠን በሐጢአታችን ፋንታ
እንደምስኪን ደሃ አንገቱን ቀልሶ……እሰይ የምስራች
ምህረት ላረገልን እምባችን አብሶ… እሰይ የምስራች
ከባርነት ቀምበር ፍፁም ነፃ ወጣ …እሰይ የምስራች
ደስይለናል ባንተ በትንሳኤው ብርሃን…እሰይየምስራች
ከለሜዳ ለብሶ እርቃኑን የቆመው …..እሰይ የምስራች
የኛ መድኃኒዓለም ሞትን ድልአረገው…እሰይ የምስራች
ጨረቃና ከዋክብት ደም ለአለቀሱለት…እሰይ የምስራች
ሞትን ድልለነሳው እናመስግን በእውነት…እሰይ የምስራች
መቅደላዊት ማርያም በጣም ደስይበልሽ…እሰይየምስራች
አምላክሽ ተነስቷል ከሐጢአት ያነፃሽ…እሰይ የምስራች
እናንተ ሐዋርያት በእምነት የፀናችሁ…እሰይ የምስራች
ፍራቻው ይወገድ ተነስቷል ጌታችሁ…እሰይ የምስራች
ንገሩ ለዓለም ያረገላችሁን…… ……እሰይ የምስራች
ከሲኦል እስራት ያላቀቃችሁን…… …እሰይ የምስራች
እሰይ የምስራች ሰይጣን ድል ተመታ…እሰይ የምስራች
ዝማሬን እናቅርብ ሁላችን በእልልታ …እሰይ የምስራች

right.title: Inde Igziabher Yale Manm Yelemna
right.description: This mezmur glorifies the unmatched power of God, declaring that there is none like Him. It recalls mighty biblical miracles such as the parting of the Red Sea, the fall of Pharaoh, and the collapse of Jericho's walls, showing that God lifts the weak and humbles the strong. It also emphasizes His protection against enemies and His authority over nature. The chant ultimately calls believers to stand in praise, recognizing that nothing is impossible for God, the Savior of the world.

right.title: Silasen Amesginu
right.description: This mezmur is a joyful declaration of praise to the Holy Trinity—Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. It emphasizes that all creation, from angels to humanity, is called to worship and glorify God. The chant reflects on God's provision, protection, and guidance in daily life, encouraging continual praise both day and night. It calls believers to join in the heavenly worship, honoring God with gratitude and devotion.

right.title: Qwanqwaye Nesh Dingil
right.description: This mezmur honors the Virgin Mary as the spiritual mediator through whom believers approach God. It expresses humility, acknowledging unworthiness before God, and gratitude for her intercession which allows prayers to be heard. The chant reflects transformation through her love, turning a sinful life into one of praise and holiness. It emphasizes that through honoring her, believers draw closer to God, and it celebrates the joy and peace that fill the soul when praising her, following the example of the saints.

left.title: Demeqe Aberaln
left.title_english: Illuminating Are the Works of Emmanuel
left.description:
Original Song: Demeke Aberalin
Original Singer: Mahibere Selam

Illuminating are the works of Emmanuel 
Abraham and Sara we see in the couple 

In the house of the Lord under its shade they stood 
A crown of righteousness they wore the bride and groom 
For they received the grace of the Holy Spirit 
The bride and groom will shine their demeanor is lit

For these two separate hearts become one under God
Lets Praise almighty Lord and rejoice with a song 
“Your bones are from my ribs and your flesh from my flesh” 
Testaments of Adam today we all witnessed

The light of the crown is visible among us 
Mystery of unity magnified in this house
He who made us worthy to see this engagement 
Glory be to God who revealed this sacrament

In union they both stood adorned in robes of white 
Resting under the shade of Holy Spirit's might 
Conquered were both the bride and the groom with one love 
In eucharist to partake wearing white like the doves

በመስቀል ላይ ተሰቀለ ዳንኩኝ እኔ እርሱ ታሞ

እንዲመቸኝ ዝቅ ብሎ በበረት ውስጥ እርሱ አደረ
ላመስግነው(3) ፍቅሩ የማያልቅ ነው/2/
አዝ……………….
ቅኔ ባፈስ ምን ይደንቃል ደሙን በመስቀል አፍስሶ
ስለልጁ መዳን ብሎ ነፍሱን ሳይቀር ለኔ ክሶ
ፍቅር ይዞት ከፀባኦት በትህትና ወቶ ወርዶ
ተቀደስኩኝ በነጩ በግ ቀራንዮ ጌታ ታርዶ
ላመስግነው(፫) ፍቅሩ የማያልቅ ነው/2/
አዝ……………….
አክሊለ ሦክ አጠለቀ ግርማ ክብሩን ሁሉ ትቶ

አጎንብሶ ቀና አረገኝ ፊቴን በጽድቅ እያበራ
እኖራለሁ ለዘላለም ካከበረኝ ጌታ ጋራ
ላመስግነው(3) ፍቅሩ የማያልቅ ነው/2/

right.title: Dingil Imebete
right.description: This mezmur is a devotional hymn to the Virgin Mary, honoring her as the helper, foundation, and source of blessing in the believer’s life. It praises her humility, spiritual beauty, and role as a refuge like Zion and the tent of Abraham. The chant also invokes the archangels, showing the heavenly connection and honor surrounding her. It expresses deep love and testimony to her intercession, affirming that her presence strengthens faith and brings grace. Ultimately, it is a declaration of lifelong devotion, remembering her name across generations and trusting in her as a constant source of help and blessing.

left.title: Baknyalehuna
left.description: This mezmur is a heartfelt plea to the Virgin Mary for help and comfort in times of struggle. It describes the hardships and temptations of the world as overwhelming, comparing life to a vast sea and the soul to a small boat in need of guidance. The singer turns to the Virgin as a source of hope, strength, and direction, trusting in her intercession to prevent falling into despair. It reflects humility, dependence, and deep devotion, affirming that she is the believer’s true refuge, guide, and spiritual profit in both day and night.

left.title: Ityopyawiw Tsadiq
left.description:
Originally by: Liqe Mezemeran Tewodros Yosef: https://youtu.be/mxRuy9CafVM?si=4geVcuJC8bKb2X7V

Chorus
Who is the righteous one of Ethiopia’s land?
I asked, with a longing to touch where you would stand.
I sought out your blessing, with my heart opened wide,
I came to your door and tasted your love inside.

ኢትዮጵያዊው ፃድቅ ማን ነው ብዬ ጠየኩ
በረከት ፈልጌ ልሳለመው ናፈኩ
ክብሩን ልመሰክር ተፈታ ምላሴ
ከደጁ ደርሼ ፍቅሩን በመቅመሴ

Verse:
seed in Ityisa, in faith you were grown,
You left all the world for the Lord alone.
Debre Libanos stands living and strong,
Proclaiming your glory in prayer in song.
Tekle Haymanot, beloved 
My home and my abode are blessed

Verse:
Lord who exalts you has crowned you with grace,
now you are near us, unseen in this place.
In humility we stand, at your gate
prayers of the righteous are grand great
Tekle Haymanot, a bright sun 
Let grace pour upon me from heaven

Verse:
led us to pastures so living and green,
fed us the Word, pure and gentle and clean.
The Gospel’s bright torch your hands set aflame
Enlightend all ages in the lords name.
Tekle Haymanot, beloved
My home and my abode are blessed

Verse:
bore thirty, sixty, a hundred once more,
Stood at debre asbo, one foot on the floor.
Bartholomew’s hope fulfilled in your way,
The Lord’s holy path was straightened that day.
Tekle Haymanot, beloved 
My home and my abode are blessed

left.title: Nisebho
left.description:
Let us give praise (2) to the Almighty God
We praise Him for He is glorified (2)


We have crossed through the sea the waters have run dry
Upon our enemies triumphantly we rise 
We were freed from their hold the chains of slavery
The bread that gives us life is truly heavenly

-----------
 
Trials that caused us fear abundant they all were 
We have passed through them all with our Lord and Savior
Though we may lose our strength weakened by obstacles
Our salvation is God He makes all possible

----------

We drank holy water that flowed from the boulder
We praise God Almighty who is full of wonder
Come all let us rejoice our lives have been redeemed
Our enemy Satan he has left in defeat

right.title: Covenant of Mercy
right.description: This mezmur is a heartfelt devotion to the Holy Virgin Mary under the title of Kidane Mehret (Covenant of Mercy). It expresses patience, suffering, and ultimate consolation through her intercession. The chant reflects the believer’s reliance on the Mother of God during hardship, emphasizing her compassion, protection, and healing power. It highlights themes of endurance, faith, and the peace and comfort found through her prayers, leading to restoration and spiritual strength.
